headword: {上方|じょうほう}{修正|しゅうせい}
reading: じょうほうしゅうせい

definitions.explanation: a correction or revision of a figure, forecast, or estimate to a higher value

examples.japanese: {業績|ぎょうせき}{予想|よそう}を{上方|じょうほう}{修正|しゅうせい}した。
examples.english: The earnings forecast was revised upward.

examples.japanese: GDP{成長率|せいちょうりつ}が{上方|じょうほう}{修正|しゅうせい}された。
examples.english: The GDP growth rate was revised upward.

examples.japanese: {好調|こうちょう}な{売上|うりあげ}を{受|う}け、{会社|かいしゃ}は{通期|つうき}{見通|みとお}しの{上方|じょうほう}{修正|しゅうせい}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: In response to strong sales, the company announced an upward revision of its full-year outlook.

notes:
A business and economics term meaning to revise a numerical estimate or forecast to a higher value. Composed of {上方|じょうほう} (upward) + {修正|しゅうせい} (revision, correction). Very frequently seen in financial news, earnings announcements, and government economic reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {業績|ぎょうせき}の{上方|じょうほう}{修正|しゅうせい} — upward revision of earnings
- {上方|じょうほう}{修正|しゅうせい}する — to revise upward
- {上方|じょうほう}{修正|しゅうせい}を{発表|はっぴょう}する — to announce an upward revision
- {大幅|おおはば}な{上方|じょうほう}{修正|しゅうせい} — a significant upward revision

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下方|かほう}{修正|しゅうせい} — downward revision (the opposite)
- {見直|みなお}し — review, reassessment (broader; not necessarily numerical)
- {改定|かいてい} — revision (of rules, rates, or standards)
